## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -14.14%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.29%) ABOVE TREND provide independent confirmation of risk appetite, while XLK (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +5.77%) ABOVE TREND shows leadership breadth.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -14.14%) BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds rising: SPY/TLT (SPY 1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.29% ABOVE TREND; TLT 1W: +0.12% | 1M: +0.15% ABOVE TREND) confirming risk-on skew. Credit watch: Credit Spread (Level 0.7322) 1W: +0.17% → flat ABOVE TREND signals modestly higher stress to monitor.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-looser conditions: UUP proxy (Dollar) (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -1.83%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve (1W: -0.03% | 1M: +0.44%) CORRECTION, while TLT (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND shows bond support.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Growth/momentum leadership: XLK (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +5.77%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +9.44%) ABOVE TREND are both strong, with XLI (1W: +4.17% | 1M: +3.74%) ABOVE TREND and XLY (1W: +2.70% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND showing cyclical participation — style: Growth/momentum leading.

**5. US vs Global?**
Emerging markets outpacing US this week: EEM (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND vs SPY (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.29%) ABOVE TREND; China FXI (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND but lagging broader EM strength.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk-on tone: IWM (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +7.33%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +4.59% | 1M: +1.87%) ABOVE TREND show small-cap and thematic appetite, IBIT (1W: +5.24% | 1M: +4.11%) ABOVE TREND confirms crypto ETF inflows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation signs: CPER (1W: +7.26% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND and broad materials (Materials 1W: +5.22% | 1M: +7.43%) ABOVE TREND; precious metals are in RECOVERY with GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -6.75%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -10.72%) RECOVERY — inflation mix favors cyclical commodities.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weakening: XLE (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND with UNG (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -18.10%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -10.24% | 1M: +1.70%) in CORRECTION — watch for continued downside pressure in energy-related ETFs.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: VXX down and SPY/QQQ/IWM all ABOVE TREND (SPY 1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.29%; QQQ 1W: +4.91% | 1M: +3.50%; IWM 1W: +5.04% | 1M: +7.33%) validate the RISK-ON read. DIVERGENCE: Energy/commodities (USO 1W: -7.54% | 1M: +8.51% CORRECTION; BNO CORRECTION) are showing MINOR divergence vs equities.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum and cyclicals: XLK (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +5.77%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX/Semiconductor leadership (SOXX 1W: +14.31% | 1M: +19.20%) ABOVE TREND, and EEM (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy ETFs XLE (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND and nat-gas UNG (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -18.10%) BELOW TREND, and monitor credit spreads/HYG_LQD.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Semiconductors SOXX (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +19.20%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through; Materials/CPER (CPER 1W: +7.26% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND if reflation continues. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND and nat-gas UNG (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -18.10%) BELOW TREND on weak flows.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/CPER (1W: +7.26% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND as a cyclical barometer. BEARISH: Oil/USO (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +8.51%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -10.24% | 1M: +1.70%) CORRECTION — watch inventory/pricing shocks.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (sentiment pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health hinge), Tech vs Financials 2.82 (current level 2.8186 — leadership pivot), CPER momentum breakouts above current 1W gains.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and VXX (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -14.14%) BELOW TREND with SPY (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.29%) ABOVE TREND confirm broad risk appetite. Tech and semiconductors (XLK 1W: +6.46% | 1M: +5.77% ABOVE TREND; SOXX 1W: +14.31% | 1M: +19.20% ABOVE TREND) showing strength while energy (XLE 1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.05% BELOW TREND) is the primary weakness to monitor. Key risk: rising credit spread signals and energy/commodity divergences that could cap breadth if they widen.
